name: Rowan Thakur-Vestergaard-Madrigal
role: Tailor and seamstress, Lakeview Neon district
location: Lakeview Neon, a narrow second-floor shop above a synth-sake bar called The Peristaltic, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Brenno is lanky and precise, the kind of man who looks slightly annoyed at rest but is actually just concentrating. He has warm-amber skin, dark eyes with geneware irises that shift between deep violet and burnt gold depending on his mood — installed partly for aesthetics, mostly because he wanted to test how clients reacted to them before doing a full commission. His hands are his most important feature: long-fingered, callus-mapped, perpetually holding something — chalk, thread, a measuring tape coiled around two knuckles. He keeps his head shaved and wears a single garnet stud in his left ear that has been there since he was nineteen.

He works at the seam between tiers: his clients are Tier 2 people who want to look Tier 3, and occasional Tier 3 people who want something that doesn't look corporate-issued. He is perceptive about bodies and what people want their bodies to say, which makes him an accidental confessor — clients will tell him things in the fitting room they'd tell nobody else. He is not a gossip, but he is an archivist. He remembers everything.

core_fears: being seen as merely serviceable — talented enough to be useful, not enough to matter
losing the use of his hands
core_desires: to make something that outlasts him — a piece of work that gets passed down
to be understood without having to explain himself
coping_mechanisms: Retreats into technical problem-solving when emotionally overwhelmed — if he's recutting a seam for the fifth time, something is wrong
blind_spots: Assumes that understanding someone's surface (their body, their clothing choices) means he understands them — misses emotional subtexts
Undercharges chronically because he'd rather have a good client than a profitable one
psychology.secret: He has been slowly, carefully reproducing — from memory and old photographs — the entire wardrobe of his grandmother who died in the Irkalla flooding of 2189. He has no plan for what to do with these garments when finished. He thinks maybe he's just trying to make her real again.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and image-rich. Uses clothing and construction metaphors for everything. Intermittent Twi and Serbian phrases, usually terms of endearment or mild curses.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with long pauses while he thinks. Can be surprisingly cutting when he finally finishes a sentence.
verbal_tics: Starts sentences with 'The thing is—' when he's about to say something actually true
Refers to difficult people as 'a bad fabric' or 'cheap interfacing'
example_lines: 'The thing is — you're not a large, you're just being measured by someone who doesn't understand your proportions. They're different things.'
'She told me everything in the second fitting. Always the second fitting. First time they're nervous. Third time they've decided. Second time — that's when they actually talk.'

story_hooks: A client left behind a jacket with a hidden pocket containing a sealed data chip — the client hasn't come back to collect it and it's been six weeks. Brenno doesn't know what's on it but he's starting to think he should find out before someone comes looking.

A corporate procurement agent from Tessera has offered him a contract to make uniforms for a new Lakeview Neon development project — the pay is extraordinary. Accepting it would mean closing his independent commissions for eight months and dressing the people responsible for gentrifying his neighborhood.
narrative_function: Information source — knows the secrets of half the block from fitting-room confessions. Can be a quest-giver related to a client in trouble. His shop is a neutral ground that different types of people pass through.
augmentations: Geneware patterned irises (violet-to-gold shift). Micro-stabilizers in both hands (Tier 2 medical, prevents tremor — installed after a nerve injury from a sewing machine accident at 24). Subdermal thimble caps on three fingers of each hand.
daily_life: Opens at 10:00, rarely leaves the shop before 22:00. Mornings are admin and cutting; afternoons are fittings; evenings are his real work — the intricate construction he only does when the street noise drops to manageable. Eats from Ogechi's cart three times a week when he can get down there.
affiliation: Independent; informal referral network with two other tailors in the Burnished Market

decision_rules: Never take a commission from someone whose body language reads as dishonest — he will always be blamed when the relationship sours
Protect the fitting room's confidentiality as an absolute rule
escalation_ladder: Pretends not to have heard the problematic thing
Redirects to technical discussion of the garment
States his position in one sentence and goes quiet
Asks the person to leave and completes their order through a drop-box

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional, slightly formal, uses clothing assessment as a social crutch — he is always doing something with his hands to avoid direct eye contact
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm and funny, will cook for you badly and be offended when you notice, remembers every significant thing you've ever said to him

stress_responses.low: Becomes over-particular about irrelevant details. Re-pins things that were already correct.
stress_responses.medium: Works through the night. Emerges exhausted and briefly gentle.
stress_responses.high: Goes to the roof with the grandmother garments and sits with them in the dark.

contradictions: Claims not to care about beauty for its own sake — only about function and fit — but will spend unpaid hours perfecting something no one will notice
habits: Hums Serbian folk songs under his breath while cutting, completely unconsciously
Checks his hand stabilizers against a fine thread test every morning before opening
breaking_points: Anyone touching his grandmother project without permission
The micro-stabilizers failing — this is a recurring nightmare

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Siege Mortar SM-8 'Tremor'

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American, South Asian, and East Asian ancestry—a complex tri-continental blend resulting in warm, golden-bronze skin with subtle warm undertones. The genetic mix creates distinctive facial architecture: higher cheekbones with gentle angularity from East Asian heritage, warm depth from South Asian ancestry, and the sun-kissed warmth of Hispanic/Latin American genetics.
physical_description.build: Lanky and angular, almost concave through the chest—the build of someone who has spent two decades bent over a work table. Long limbs with visible musculature only in forearms and shoulders from repetitive precision work.
physical_description.hair_style: Completely shaved, scalp maintained smooth with occasional faint surgical-grade scarring from old augmentation work
physical_description.eye_color: Geneware irises—deep violet at rest, shifting to burnt gold under emotional intensity or bright light; sclera warm brown
physical_description.skin_tone: Golden-bronze with warm undertones—the result of blended Hispanic/Latin American, South Asian, and East Asian ancestry. Luminous in natural light, deepening subtly in shadow.
physical_description.complexion: Clean, minimal acne scarring. Fine lines around eyes from decades of close-focus work and squinting. A small burn scar on the bridge of his nose (accidental). Perpetually neat despite the work—someone who understands the power of presentation. Slight downward set to his mouth at rest, giving an impression of concentration or mild disapproval. Facial structure reflects tri-continental heritage: defined cheekbones, warm eye setting, refined jawline.
distinguishing_marks: Garnet stud earring in left ear lobe, worn continuously since age nineteen—slightly darkened from oxidation
Network of pale thread-thin scars across both palms and inner wrists from sewing machine accidents and needle work
Small burn scar on bridge of nose, roughly 1cm, pale and flat
Faint circular scarring on both wrists (internal augmentation access points from micro-stabilizer installation, now barely visible)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware patterned irises are the primary visible modification—noticeable in person but not immediately jarring. Subdermal thimble caps are invisible under normal light but create slight surface irregularities on the index, middle, and ring finger of each hand if examined closely. Hands move with mechanical precision that suggests augmentation to trained observers. No visible chrome or external hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with a slight forward lean, as if perpetually leaning over a work surface. Shoulders rolled inward. Movements are economical and precise—no wasted motion. Hands are always occupied or positioned near fabric; he handles textiles with the deliberation others reserve for explosives. Walks with purpose but not haste. Rarely makes sudden movements.
physical_description.clothing_style: High-Tier 2 aesthetic executed with Tier 3 practicality. Typically wears fitted but functional garments—tailored merino blend shirts in neutral grays, blacks, deep blues; straight-cut work pants with reinforced pockets and seams (often his own creation); a charcoal or black overshirt or light jacket, always open. Shoes are understated—quality leather derby or slip-ons, well-maintained but worn. A cloth tape measure usually coiled around his neck or wrist. Jewelry is minimal: the garnet earring, occasionally a thin steel bracelet on his right wrist. His clothes fit him perfectly because he is his own first client. Nothing cheap, nothing flashy. Everything says 'I know what I'm doing.'
